title: "Plotting UK Grid temperatures during the heatwave and not heatwave years"

output: html_document
---
          - Code to replicate plots and analyses of: A record-breaking heatwave reduces breeding success and impairs growth in a wild bird population -
                                    Plotting UK Grid temperatures during the heatwave and not heatwave years
          
                                 
The rasters required to reproduce these plots are available at: https://dap.ceda.ac.uk/badc/ukmo-hadobs/data/insitu/MOHC/HadOBS/HadUK-Grid/v1.3.2.ceda/1km/tasmax/day/v20260512/ #[Accessed July 2026]                                 
#1. Load packages
```{r}
library(terra)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyterra)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(sf)
library(scales)
```
                               
#2. Plot
```{r}
#1. Load heatwave year rasters

r_2026 <- rast("~tasmax_hadukgrid_uk_1km_day_20260501-20260531.nc") #from your wd

dates_2026 <- as.Date(time(r_2026))
idx_25_26_2026 <- which(dates_2026 %in% as.Date(c("2026-05-25", "2026-05-26"))) #select days of interest
r_25_26_2026 <- r_2026[[idx_25_26_2026]]
r_mean_25_26_2026 <- mean(r_25_26_2026, na.rm = TRUE)

crs(r_mean_25_26_2026) <- "EPSG:27700"

#2. Load nonheatwave years
data_dir <- "~wd"   

may_files <- list.files(
  path       = data_dir,
  pattern    = "^tasmax_hadukgrid_uk_1km_day_.*\\.nc$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

length(may_files)

get_may_25_26_mean <- function(f) {
  r <- rast(f)
  d <- time(r)
  keep <- format(d, "%m-%d") %in% c("05-25", "05-26")
  if (!any(keep)) return(NULL)
  mean(r[[keep]], na.rm = TRUE)
}

yearly_means <- lapply(may_files, get_may_25_26_mean)
yearly_means <- yearly_means[!sapply(yearly_means, is.null)]

length(yearly_means) 

r_stack           <- rast(yearly_means)
r_mean_25_26_hist <- mean(r_stack, na.rm = TRUE)

crs(r_mean_25_26_hist) <- "EPSG:27700"

#3. Plot

isles <- ne_countries(scale = "large", country = c("United Kingdom", "Ireland"), returnclass = "sf")
isles <- st_transform(isles, "EPSG:27700")

wytham <- st_sf(
  name = "Wytham Woods",
  geometry = st_sfc(st_point(c(-1.3361506763124116, 51.76974195389728)), crs = 4326)
)
wytham <- st_transform(wytham, "EPSG:27700")

lat50 <- st_sf(geometry = st_sfc(st_point(c(-2, 49.5)), crs = 4326))
lat50 <- st_transform(lat50, "EPSG:27700")
lat50_northing <- st_coordinates(lat50)[, "Y"]

range_2026 <- range(values(r_mean_25_26_2026), na.rm = TRUE)
range_hist <- range(values(r_mean_25_26_hist), na.rm = TRUE)

r_min <- floor(min(range_2026[1], range_hist[1]))
r_max <- ceiling(max(range_2026[2], range_hist[2]))

shared_breaks <- scales::breaks_pretty(n = 6)(c(r_min, r_max)) |> c(r_max) |> unique() |> sort()

plot_ext <- ext(r_mean_25_26_2026)

make_map <- function(raster, subtitle_label, panel_letter = NULL) {
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = isles, fill = "grey95", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_spatraster(data = raster) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      option = "inferno",
      name = NULL,                     # <-- no "Tmax (°C)" title
      na.value = NA,
      limits = c(r_min, r_max),
      breaks = shared_breaks,
      labels = paste0(shared_breaks, "\u00b0C"),   # <-- ticks read "5°C", "10°C", ...
      guide = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 1.5, barheight = 8)
    ) +
    geom_sf(data = wytham, colour = "black", fill = "white", shape = 21, size = 3.5, stroke = 1) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
      legend.position = "inside",
      legend.position.inside = c(0.05, 0.95),
      legend.justification = c(0, 1),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.7), colour = NA),
      legend.title = element_text(margin = margin(b = 12), hjust = 0.5, size = 13),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11)
    ) +
    coord_sf(
      xlim = c(plot_ext[1] - 20000, plot_ext[2] + 20000),
      ylim = c(lat50_northing, plot_ext[4] + 20000),
      expand = FALSE
    )

  if (!is.null(panel_letter)) {
    p <- p + annotate(
      "text",
      x = -Inf, y = Inf,
      label = panel_letter,
      hjust = -0.4, vjust = 1.6,   # nudges it just inside the top-left corner
      size = 6, fontface = "plain"
    )
  }

  p
}

p_2026 <- make_map(r_mean_25_26_2026, "25-26 May 2026", panel_letter = "A")
p_hist <- make_map(r_mean_25_26_hist, "25-26 May climatology, 1921-2015", panel_letter = "B")

#join the plots of the two periods
library(cowplot)

make_map_nolegend <- function(raster, subtitle_label, panel_letter) {
  make_map(raster, subtitle_label, panel_letter) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

# Build one version with a horizontal bottom legend, purely to extract it
p_for_legend <- make_map(r_mean_25_26_2026, "25-26 May 2026") +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(
    barwidth  = 15,
    barheight = 1
  )) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

shared_legend <- get_legend(p_for_legend)
# If get_legend() isn't found: library(ggpubr); shared_legend <- get_legend(p_for_legend)

p_2026_clean <- make_map_nolegend(r_mean_25_26_2026, "25-26 May 2026", "A 2026")
p_hist_clean <- make_map_nolegend(r_mean_25_26_hist, "25-26 May climatology, 1921-2015", "B 1931-2025")

panels <- plot_grid(p_hist_clean, p_2026_clean,  nrow = 1)

# Centre the legend by padding equally on both sides rather than letting
# it sit flush left
legend_row <- plot_grid(NULL, shared_legend, NULL, nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(0.3, 1, 0.3))

final_plot <- plot_grid(panels, legend_row, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.12))

final_plot

#ggsave(
  "tasmax_2026_vs_historical_side_by_side_2.pdf",
  final_plot,
  width  = 14,
  height = 9,
  device = cairo_pdf     # ensures fonts render/embed correctly in the PDF
)
```
